thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx error rate detected for service inference-gateway (us-west-2). 15m error rate spike -> 18% 5xx, spike in timeouts and segfault-derived 502s. Pager: @oncall-jen. Link: https://ops.redwood/internal/incidents/3432109999

oncall-jen: I'm on it. Pinging runtime team @laura-runtime and infra @ryan-sre. Starting triage.

laura-runtime: Looking at model-runner logs on runner-3-*. Repro: repeated SIGSEGV in quant_kernels.so right after kv-cache restore. Suspect quantized-attention path.

sam-eng: Seeing OOMs and kernel faults stacked: `oom-killer` killed `model-runner` on runner-3-4 at ~T0+4m. dmesg excerpt:
```
[12345.678901] model-runner invoked oom-killer: gfp_mask=0x12000
[12345.679012] Killed process 98765 (model-runner) total-vm:20480000kB
[12345.679015] segfault at 0 ip 00007f1e2a3b4c5d sp 00007ffeabcd1234 error 4 in quant_kernels.so[7f1e2a000000+200000]
```

ryan-sre: Gateway metrics show increased 502/504s and client retries. Route error heatmap points to us-west-2 region. Customer impact: elevated latency and some request failures for default model routes.

maya-support: Two paid customers (AcmeAnalytics, BrightForms) opened severity-high tickets about repeat failures and degraded throughput. I flagged both to account execs.

oncall-jen: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Reroute trafffic for model version v2.3 away from us-west-2 to us-west-1 for affected customers. 2) Disable quantized kernel fastpath on the runner pool as a hot rollback. 3) Collect heap/kvcache profiles and core dumps for postmortem. Executing step 1 now.

infra-bot: routemap update requested: `reroute model=v2.3 region=us-west-1 remove=us-west-2 reason="runtime segfaults"`
infra-bot: routemap update successful.

laura-runtime: Starting disabled-kernel rollout: patching runtime config `quant.enabled=false` for pool model-runner-pool-3 and performing rolling restarts (graceful drain).

sam-eng: Rolling restart progress: 6/12 nodes drained and restarted, traffic shifted off each node as it comes up. Initial nodes show reduced RSS peaks.

laura-runtime: After router reroute + kernel disable, 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> ~1.8% in last 5m. Latency for affected routes trending back to baseline.

ryan-sre: Confirming customer-facing errors decreased. We'll keep the reroute in place for 1h while we gather artifacts. Recommend notifying customers with incident alert.

product-lee: Drafting a short customer-facing update now. Will call out mitigation steps and ETA for postmortem.

maya-support: Sending interim notice to AcmeAnalytics and BrightForms that we've rerouted traffic and are collecting logs; offering callback.

oncall-jen: Handoff: I'll keep an eye during ramp-down for 30m then hand to daytime oncall @ryan-sre. Action items for follow-up:
- collect core dumps + heap profiles from runner-3-4, runner-3-7
- create IR ticket IR-34321 with crash artifacts and quant-kernel blame hypothesis
- reproduce locally with quant path disabled/enabled to confirm root cause

ryan-sre: Taking over in 35m. Please drop any leftover logs in the incident ticket. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

laura-runtime: Pushed collection scripts to /tmp/ir-34321 and triggered `gcore` on the two crashed processes before they were restarted. Uploaded to internal artifacts bucket `s3://redwood-ir/34321/`.

sam-eng: Note: there are a few older nodes with mixed driver versions; adding driver-version matrix to the ticket. Could be memory corruption triggered by older GPU driver + quant kernel combination.

oncall-jen: Closing pager for now; mitigation in place. Will keep incident channel open for postmortem updates.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. Impact: partial client failures (see tickets), routing fallback applied. Next steps: postmortem + root cause analysis assigned to runtime (laura-runtime) and eng (sam-eng).
